description: Body of an adapter's GET /measurement/{positioningId}, read by the positioning engine. See docs/adapters.md.

source.description: Short tag of the positioning technology. Defaults to the adapter's registered name.
source.title: Source

frame.description: Reference of the horizontal position. `room`: x, y from the lower-left corner of the room named by `room`. `venue`: x, y from the lower-left corner of the floor plan. `wgs84`: latitude, longitude.
frame.title: Frame

room.description: Blueprint room id. Required with frame `room`.
room.title: Room

x.description: Along the width. Required with frame `room` or `venue`.
x.title: X

y.description: Along the depth. Required with frame `room` or `venue`.
y.title: Y

z.description: Height above the venue floor, in every frame. Sent only by a source that declares `z: true`, and only when measured for this fix.
z.title: Z

accuracy.description: One-sigma horizontal error radius. When absent, the engine uses the nominal accuracy of the adapter's declared accuracy class.
accuracy.title: Accuracy

confidence.description: The source's own reliability score, a multiplier on the fusion weight.
confidence.title: Confidence

timestamp.description: When the fix was taken, Unix epoch seconds.
timestamp.title: Timestamp

lastSeen.description: When the device last communicated with its source, Unix epoch seconds.
lastSeen.title: Lastseen

diagnostics.description: Stream-tier diagnostics, carried to the position stream.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics

title: Adapter measurement
